Speech Content Editing.primary_label: Edit Instruction (one change at a time)

Speech Content Editing.example: Change 'meeting this afternoon' to 'meeting tomorrow morning'
Speech Content Editing.note: Can also use: Delete 'um'; insert 'please' before 'come in'. Full original text in optional box for duration estimation.
